name.zh: 风格化 Aulopora（喇叭网珊瑚）

description.en: Its distinguishing construction is low encrusting network of branching tubes ending in upturned trumpet mouths; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
description.zh: 以低矮附生分枝管网末端为上翘喇叭口为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired art using recognizable basic anatomy; not strict scientific, species/specimen, exact dimension, locomotion or coexistence reconstruction.

sources.title: Virtual Collection: Tabulate Corals (Tabulata) - Digital Atlas of Ancient Life
sources.supports: Group-level shell/skeleton form and explicitly named fossil specimens only. Modern specimens on the same page do not establish prehistoric occurrence.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.use: consulted-only; no source media, mesh or texture incorporated
sources.rights_note: No third-party license grant inferred from consultation.

uncertainties.en: Original stylized teaching concept. Palette, nominal dimensions, pose and simplified counts are artistic. No microscopic genus diagnosis, measured specimen, behavior or coexistence reconstruction.
uncertainties.zh: 原创风格化教学概念；配色、标称尺寸、姿态及简化数量为美术选择。不声称微观属级鉴别、标本实测、行为或同域共存复原。

reference_access.location: Encrusting tabulate corals: specimen PRI 76739 caption
reference_access.observation: Named Aulopora encrusting Favosites; basic creeping-network interpretation only; original trumpet geometry, no model/image copied.
reference_access.limitations: Text/captions read; embedded Sketchfab meshes not downloaded, loaded or incorporated. Historical ledger preserved separately. Reference media rights remain with creators.
